topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder weighing AEOeye against Quattr wants to know which tool fits their job, what each costs, which AI engines each covers, and where Quattr is the better pick.
topic.connection: AEOeye runs one-time AI visibility audits (free ChatGPT check, $29 five-engine report) for the same buyer questions a platform like Quattr tracks continuously; the page explains the difference honestly and recommends Quattr where ongoing execution is the real need.

assessment: The page is based on Quattr's own public pages (pricing, homepage, AI visibility overview, Quattr vs Profound comparison, G2 press release) read on 2026-10-03 and says in its first lines that we have not used Quattr hands-on and that AEOeye is our product. It replaces the earlier version's stale or wrong claims (a 'multi-engine' free audit, third-party $79-$99 a month pricing, reviewer hearsay about learning curve and trial approval, 'deeper multi-engine querying activates with usage') with what Quattr states itself, labelled as Quattr's claims. It gives a clear verdict, says plainly where Quattr is stronger (daily tracking, first-party data joins, prepared fixes, strategist), uses SparkToro's run-to-run variance research to explain why repetition matters, flags that Quattr labels its own case-study outcomes observational with no causal claim, and states AEOeye's limits. It deliberately does not state any Quattr price, rate its data accuracy, quote G2 reviewers, or claim hands-on testing.

sources.supports: Pricing page is a demo request form with no price or plan; ticks 'No credit card', '30-min call', 'Free trial included'; company-size options from 1-50 employees; 4.9/5 from 65 G2 reviews (confirmed in raw HTML via curl and WebFetch).

Quattr's own comparison page: pricing 'Custom pricing (based on your use cases...)'; tracking 'Real consumer experience tracking (Not API-based)'; WordPress native CMS publishing 'now'; Search Console, GA4 and other first-party joins; 'Looker Enterprise edition embedded'; FAQ listing demo, sandbox, free trial, proof of concept or paid pilot as trial routes.

AI answers observed daily on tracked prompts; read-only by default; Quattr's labels on case-study outcomes ('Observational, outcomes reported for the optimized cohort; no causal claim') and CloudEagle figures (3x AI citation share, 113% organic click growth, 12-week pilot).

'The AI search growth platform'; engines named (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews); 'You control what goes live'; GIGA prepares page refreshes, new pages and fixes; Internal Linking AI with reversible, sampled-before-rollout edge links; every customer works with a Strategist, biweekly cadence typical, weekly available as an upgrade; read-only MCP; no price shown.
March 2026 press release describes Quattr as a platform that helps 'mid-market and enterprise brands' win citations in AI answers and rankings.

600 volunteers, 12 prompts, ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI, 2,961 runs; under 1 in 100 chance ChatGPT or Google's AI repeats the same brand list; ask 60-100 times and average; research done with Gumshoe.ai (confirmed in raw HTML).
Wikipedia defines generative engine optimization (also answer engine optimization) as the practice of improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems (confirmed in raw HTML).
